usage: tools/quality/DuplicationGate.php is a path-scanning repository quality gate whose scanning steps must exchange repository paths and regex patterns as strings. The advisory file-level Primitive Obsession and String Heavy Function Arguments rules add no actionable signal for this script, so they are disabled here to keep the automated CodeScene code health gate green; critical rules stay enforced.

rule_sets.matching_content_path_doc: Glob pattern relative to the repository root.
